purpose: Original conceptual editorial covers; not experimental figures or photographs of the author's work.
sharedPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape cover illustration for a professional AI engineering article. Style: sophisticated scientific editorial 3D illustration, restrained and precise, tactile matte materials, soft studio side lighting, credible geometry, quiet high-end technical journal. Wide 16:9 composition, principal subject in central 70 percent so the website crop remains safe, full-bleed background, crisp details. Palette: near-black graphite #08080a, charcoal, ivory, only a restrained lime #b7ff3c accent. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, human faces, decorative fake dashboard, or exaggerated neon glow. This is an original conceptual illustration, not a measurement or a reproduction of a paper figure.

images.subject: An elegant physical interpretation of an artificial neural network: three parallel translucent planes of small graphite nodes, fine restrained lime connections between the layers, an input signal entering at left and a coherent geometric feature emerging at right. Emphasize learned representations rather than a literal brain.

A neural web of fine graphite filaments and sparse lime-lit nodes resolves into a precise arrangement of ivory geometric proof objects: a triangle, compass arcs, and a clean logical branching structure. Learned perception meeting explicit mathematical reasoning, one coherent scientific still life.

A precise assembly of modular graphite geometric components, cubes, arches and short connecting rods, repeated familiar pieces recombined into a new stable structure. Show a small set of loose components in the foreground and their composition behind, without arrows or labels.

An event-driven neuromorphic microcircuit as a refined 3D scientific illustration: sparse lime pulses travelling along a few fine parallel traces across a matte graphite substrate, tiny bright events separated by long quiet intervals. A subtle pulse-raster motif is visible as short marks in space. No literal biological brain.

A continuous sculpted fluid surface constrained by a precise boundary frame and sparse measurement points, with a delicate graphite wire mesh converging to the surface. A few lime contour lines describe physical consistency. This is a conceptual artwork about data meeting physical laws, never a real simulation result.

A precision graphite robotic gripper poised over a small neutral machined part on a clean industrial workbench, accompanied by a very subtle adjacent wireframe digital twin of the same part in restrained lime. Clearly mechanical and physically plausible, a conceptual editorial artwork about perception, action and simulation.
